concept.title: From Signal Noise to Structured Consensus
concept.target_icp: Solo traders overwhelmed by conflicting viewpoints across many signal sources
concept.hook: Trader's screen buried under dozens of conflicting signal alerts
concept.story: A solo trader drowning in conflicting market viewpoints discovers CrowdWisdom filtering and scoring signals into a single structured consensus with entry, stop, and targets

scenes.visuals: Trader's monitor wall flooded with dozens of overlapping buy/sell alerts, ticker streams, and chat windows creating visual chaos
scenes.narration: The problem is not a lack of information; it is the noise around it.
scenes.sound: Overlapping ticker beeps, alert chimes, and chat notifications
scenes.music: Chaotic, layered electronic hum with competing rhythms

scenes.visuals: A funnel visualization draws signals from the chaos; weaker signals dim and drop out while stronger ones pass through
scenes.narration: CrowdWisdom filters and scores market viewpoints rather than treating every opinion equally.
scenes.sound: Weaker alerts fade into background; a filtering whoosh removes low-quality signals
scenes.music: Chaotic layers begin dropping out, leaving a steadier pulse

scenes.visuals: Remaining signals flow into individual scoring meters labeled Conviction, Consensus, and Recency; colored bars indicate how each viewpoint contributes to the group score
scenes.narration: Viewpoints are scored and synthesized using factors such as conviction, consensus, and recent performance.
scenes.sound: Soft mechanical scoring sounds, each meter ticking into place

scenes.visuals: All viewpoint streams converge into a single clean panel showing direction (arrow), entry price, stop-loss, and profit targets
scenes.narration: Many viewpoints converge into a structured consensus view. Each idea is structured around direction, entry, stop, and targets.
scenes.sound: A single clear chime as the consensus solidifies
scenes.music: Single melodic line emerges, calm and confident

scenes.visuals: CrowdWisdom logo appears with tagline 'Collective Intelligence for Traders' and a subtle disclaimer below
scenes.narration: CrowdWisdom Trading is a research platform; you remain in control of execution.

concept.narration: The problem is not a lack of information; it is the noise around it. CrowdWisdom filters and scores market viewpoints rather than treating every opinion equally. Many viewpoints converge into a structured consensus view, with each idea structured around direction, entry, stop-loss, and targets. CrowdWisdom Trading is a research platform; you remain in control of execution.
concept.visual_direction: Start with high-contrast chaotic signal flood; funnel visualization gradually simplifies to a clean, single consensus panel; end with CrowdWisdom branding and a small responsible disclaimer
concept.sound_direction: Layered conflicting alerts gradually filtered out; scoring meters tick into a unified pulse; single clear chime at consensus reveal
concept.music_direction: Chaotic layered electronic texture resolves to a single calm melodic line
evidence: CWT-BRAND-001: CrowdWisdom Trading is a collective-intelligence platform for traders.
CWT-BRAND-004: The problem is not a lack of information; it is the noise around it.
CWT-BRAND-005: CrowdWisdom turns many market viewpoints into a structured consensus view.
CWT-BRAND-006: Structured setups include entry, stop-loss, and targets.
CWT-PHIL-003: CrowdWisdom filters and scores market viewpoints rather than treating every opinion equally.
CWT-METH-002: Lower-quality signals are filtered out.
CWT-METH-003: Viewpoints are scored using conviction, consensus, and recent performance.
CWT-METH-005: Each idea is structured around direction, entry, stop, and targets.

source_fact_claims: CrowdWisdom is described as a collective-intelligence platform for traders (CWT-BRAND-001).
CrowdWisdom filtering and scoring of market viewpoints is described by the company (CWT-PHIL-003, CWT-METH-002, CWT-METH-003).
Structured setups with entry, stop-loss, and targets are described by the company (CWT-BRAND-006, CWT-METH-005).
CrowdWisdom positions itself as a research platform where the user controls execution (CWT-METH-006).
The solo-trading-as-data-gap framing is a company-published problem statement (CWT-ICP-003).
creative_interpretation_claims: Funnel visualization as a metaphorical representation of signal filtering
Scoring meters labeled Conviction/Consensus/Recency as visual representations of the company-described methodology (not confirmed technical implementation details)
Viewpoint streams converging into a single panel as a visual metaphor for consensus formation
limitations: 16,564 tracked trader count is a company-claimed figure (CWT-BRAND-003), not independently verified.
526 tracked predictions and 410 positive outcomes are a company-published example (CWT-CASE-004), not independently verified and does not imply future performance.
CrowdWisdom's filtering and scoring methodology is described but technical details are not fully disclosed (CWT-METH-003).
No cryptographic, hash, or blockchain technology is claimed; funnel and convergence are creative visual metaphors only.
The platform provides research; execution is controlled by the user (CWT-METH-006).
